messages:
Sam Turner: heads up, p95 on /generate spiked 09:42 UTC across prod-runtime hosts. noticed latency tail rising fast.
Priya Patel: can you drop the grafana link and rough numbers?
Sam Turner: p95 jumped from ~1.8s to ~4.6s, p99 hit ~8s, throughput steady. dashboard: https://grafana/reports/rt/196345
Diego Alvarez: checking kernels and traces. gpu-03 and gpu-07 showing increased kernel switches and many falls into scalar/slow path.
infra-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-0417-01 (runtime latency spike). Pager notified.
Priya Patel: any recent deploys? release activity shows a small runtime selector tweak merged around 09:20.
Sam Turner: that PR adjusted kernel selector to prefer `quant-compact` for seq <= 256 as an optimization.
Diego Alvarez: profile snippet (gpu-03, 09:40-09:44):
```
hotpath: kernel_select() -> quant_compact (avg 8ms) -> exec (avg 20ms)
fallback_count: before: 3 -> during: 42
kvcache_miss_rate: 0.28 -> 0.73
batch_latency_tail: 1.2ms -> 3.9ms
```
Priya Patel: kvcache miss rate jump is concerning. could be eviction churn from larger batches.
Sam Turner: adaptive-batching shows a bump in observed batch sizes for short requests; policy increased max batch cap due to a transient throughput signal.
Diego Alvarez: putting it together: selector prefers quant-compact which is slower on these nodes when cache misses are high, adaptive batching increases batch sizes, eviction churn rises -> p99 blowout.
Priya Patel: mitigation proposal (short): 1) set runtime selector back to legacy w/ feature flag, 2) throttle max batch caps for latency-SLO routes, 3) tenant-level concurrency caps for noisy tenants. agree?
Sam Turner: applying flag now: `FF_RUNTIME_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy` via prod-control-plane.
infra-bot: deploy started: platform/flags/feature-toggle v2 -> prod.
Priya Patel: lowering max_batch_tokens for /generate-latency-slo from 4096 -> 2048 via console.
Diego Alvarez: adding quick routing rule: any tenant with kvcache eviction_rate > 0.25 route to dedicated-cpu fallback pool while we stabilize.
Sam Turner: applied 50% concurrency cap to tenants t-47 and t-92 (top noisy by request rate).
Sam Turner: immediate post-mitigation snapshot:
```
p95: 4.6s -> 2.1s (partial recovery)
p99: 8s -> 3.6s
kvcache_miss_rate: 0.73 -> 0.41
fallback_count: 42 -> 9
```
Priya Patel: partial recovery looks good. next steps: run canary of new selector with conservative batch caps and increased KV eviction window, and add selector guard based on kvcache miss probe.
Diego Alvarez: captured flamegraph and perf traces: s3://redwood-perf/traces/196345-epoch1.svg. will attach NR profile diff too.
Sam Turner: low-cost guard idea: on kernel_select(), read cheap metric kvcache_miss_rate; if > 0.5 prefer legacy kernel. would avoid choosing quant-compact when cache is hot.
Priya Patel: agreed. i'll open a follow-up PR with tests + runtime flag to gate the probe. add unit tests for decision path under high miss rates.
Sam Turner: incident-bot update?
incident-bot: INC-2026-0417-01 status -> mitigated (partial). Owners: Priya, Diego, Sam. Next update scheduled in 40m or on change.
Priya Patel: retro checklist to capture: rollback window for kernel selector rollouts, perf harness for quant-compact under high cache churn, update rollout playbook to include a kvcache-miss safety check, and add route-level canary policy.
Diego Alvarez: will produce NR-profile diff and microbench kernel results tomorrow morning.
Sam Turner: thanks all. keeping thread open for PM notes and postmortem scheduling.
Priya Patel: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a 30-min postmortem and add the action items to the ticket.
